system.story: The battle-technomancer - biofeedback strikes, ICE-breaking, electronic warfare.

description.value:
Subclass: Resonance-Warrior - the Offensive Mystic. The battle-technomancer: biofeedback strikes, ICE-breaking, electronic warfare - the aggressive edge of the current. The closest the Technomancer comes to a damage dealer.

Role Feature - Killing Frequency

Your Resonance Strike hits harder and its wired-target restriction loosens (you can push biofeedback into lightly-deviced foes), and you gain the Wired chapter's offensive EW verbs at an edge.

Signature Tweak

Resonance Strike riders escalate - a Tier 1 strike can suppress or briefly seize a target's smartgun/chrome.

Bonus Skill & Contact

An EW / security-systems skill, plus a black-ICE fixer or war-decker contact.

Chrome Flavor

Moderate - leans the light-chrome allowance toward combat implants.
